verdict.rationale: PostHog documents scheduled, recurring data movement. Batch exports give "a platform to schedule data exports", the CDP sends data "in realtime or on a schedule", and the query docs point recurring exports to batch exports. Workflows add triggers, delays and steps, and the MCP exposes Workflows tools and batch_export:write scopes so agents can drive them. However, the evidence never shows a time-based or cron trigger for general-purpose workflows or jobs; scheduling is documented only for exports and pipelines. Missing for 10: explicit cron/time-scheduled workflow triggers, general recurring job scheduling beyond data exports, documented agent/MCP creation of schedules, independent hands-on corroboration.
